blocks.text: Distraction-free writing and scheduling for X and LinkedIn

Typefully is purpose-built for creators who write on X (Twitter) and LinkedIn. Unlike general social media tools that spread attention across every platform, Typefully focuses on making the writing and publishing experience for text-heavy platforms exceptional.

The editor is intentionally minimal - a blank page that encourages focused writing. Thread creation is intuitive, with visual separation between tweets and automatic character counting. For creators who treat social media as a serious writing practice, this focused environment matters.

The analytics help you understand what resonates. See which topics, formats, and posting times drive the most engagement. Over time, this data helps you develop a content strategy based on evidence rather than guesswork.
Clean writing environment purpose-built for threads and posts
Visual thread creation with auto-numbering and preview
AI suggestions for improving posts and generating ideas
Queue posts with optimal timing and auto-retweet
Engagement metrics, follower growth, and content performance
Publish to X, LinkedIn, and Threads from one editor
For anyone building a personal brand on X or LinkedIn, Typefully provides the focused writing environment and scheduling tools that general social media managers lack.
Our team can integrate Typefully into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
